product.name: Obento Health CRM Co-pilot
product.description: A mobile CRM tool designed for medical field sales, allowing users to log visits, track customer relationships, and manage business activities efficiently.

product.name: Voice-to-CRM Feature
product.description: A feature that enables users to log visits using voice commands, reducing the need for manual note-taking.

product.name: Automatic Follow-up Creation
product.description: Automatically generates follow-up tasks from notes and sends reminders to ensure timely customer interactions.

product.name: Debrief Mode
product.description: A tool that helps users reflect on visits and extract insights to prepare for future interactions.

product.name: CRM Integration
product.description: Seamlessly integrates with existing CRM systems and productivity suites to enhance user experience.
